title: krn lane run can run N attempts and select by tests
body:
Why: best-of-N with test/critic selection gives +6..16 pp across teams (CodeMonkeys, OpenHands critic, R2E-Gym; landscape.md); our n100 union ceiling is only 15/100, so this waits for derivable units.
Outcome: --attempts N runs parallel worktrees and picks the attempt whose tests pass with the smallest diff; measured on D23 v2.
Scope: src/cli/lane-run.ts, test/.
